system.description:
You can equip [Throwing] weapons. This skill only produces an effect when you have a [Throwing] weapon equipped. Increase your [Attack Power] by +[[DEX Mod] × 2]. 

(SR 2): You can use "Change Equipment" Skill with [Timing: Initiative] only if you change the weapon equipped in either [Hand Slot] to use for an attack.

A fighting style that skillfully uses throwing weapons with quick movements.
